question: As of November 2026, what is the official release date of Grand Theft Auto VI?
answer: Grand Theft Auto VI's official release date is November 19, 2026, on PlayStation 5 and Xbox Series X|S [2]. Rockstar's November 3 announcement says it launches on that date [2], and the Xbox store page lists the same date [4]. IGN reports that Rockstar has confirmed a global launch on November 19 using local midnight timing across PS5 and Xbox Series X|S [6]. PC Gamer (October 30) says no PC release date has been announced [7].
